title: People & Power - On a wing and a prayer
summary: An Al Jazeera English People & Power investigation from 2010 into safety problems with the Boeing 737NG, featuring whistleblowers on cracking parts, hand-made structural components and an alleged cover-up.
why: HN resurfaces it during Boeing safety stories as early, firsthand evidence that production and management problems long predate the 737 Max.

quote.text: Here are gruesome, firsthand details about production and management problems with the 737NG in a documentary from Al Jazeera.
